versions.changelog:
Initial release of docker-ctl-hardened.

- Enables inspection of containers, logs, and images using podman.
- Designed for Bazzite/Fedora with podman as the default, pre-installed container runtime.
- No installation required.
- Includes default security guardrails: quoting container names/IDs, displaying data in-terminal only, and blocking transmission of sensitive data over networks.
